**Big but shallow: ~1080 hits in 94 files, and most are mechanical.** 75 files under `services` are the same repo/service/route trio repeated per entity.

Four zones must not be renamed:

| Zone | Why |
|---|---|
| [`lib/serialize.js:8`](lib/serialize.js:8) | `WIRE` right side is the public JSON key |
| [`docs/openapi.yaml:16`](docs/openapi.yaml:16) | Frozen contract. Needs a new dated version |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` 4 files | Generated. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites |
| `migrations` 12 files | Already applied. Editing breaks the down step |

Rename the internal side only. Add a new migration if you want the column renamed. Sign off on the `services` and `lib/audit.js` sweep. Hold the rest.
